Bind the visual pieces (two lined) with the sound 'èr' and the 4th falling tone into a scene that means 'two'.
Bind the visual pieces (three lines) with the sound 'sān' and the 1st high and flat tone into a scene that means 'three'.
Bind the visual pieces (four lines opening, a pair of legs) with the sound 'sì' and the 4th falling tone into a scene that means 'four'.
Bind the visual pieces (five lines) with the sound 'wǔ' and the 3rd falling then rising tone into a scene that means 'five'.
